camel_example: aliyun agentidentity SetSAMLIdentityProvider --region cn-hangzhou --EntityId 'https://idp.example.com/entity' --SSOStatus Enabled --SAMLBindingType 'HTTP-Redirect' --JITUpdateStatus Enabled --X509Certificates '["-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIIDdz...\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----"]' --JITProvisionStatus Enabled --LoginURL 'https://idp.example.com/sso/saml' --UserPoolName 'my-agent-userpool' --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
kebab_example: aliyun agentidentity set-saml-identity-provider --user-pool-name my-agent-userpool --sso-status Enabled --entity-id https://idp.example.com/entity --login-url https://idp.example.com/sso/saml --x509-certificates '["-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIIDdz...\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----"]' --jit-provision-status Enabled --jit-update-status Enabled --saml-binding-type HTTP-Redirect --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetSAMLIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool
parameters.name: user_pool_name

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status of single sign-on (SSO). Valid values:
Enabled: SAML SSO is enabled, and users can log on through an external IdP.
Disabled: SAML SSO is disabled, and users cannot log on through the IdP. Default value
parameters.help_zh:
单点登录启用状态。取值：
Enabled：启用 SAML SSO，用户可通过外部 IdP 登录。
Disabled（默认值）：关闭 SAML SSO，用户无法通过 IdP 登录
parameters.name: sso_status

parameters.help_en: The IdP identifier. This is the EntityID from the SAML metadata of the external IdP
parameters.help_zh: IdP 标识。来自外部 IdP 的 SAML Metadata 中的 EntityID
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The IdP logon URL. When a user logs on, the browser is redirected to this URL to complete SAML authentication
parameters.help_zh: IdP 登录地址。用户登录时浏览器将被重定向至该地址完成 SAML 认证
parameters.name: login_url

parameters.help_en: The list of X.509 certificates in PEM format. If you specify this parameter, all existing certificates are replaced
parameters.help_zh: PEM 格式的 X509 证书列表。指定该参数会替换所有已经存在的证书
parameters.name: x509_certificates

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status of Just-In-Time (JIT) user synchronization and creation. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled. If a user with the same name does not exist in the user pool during SAML logon, automatic creation is performed.
Disabled: Shutdown. If the user is not found, the logon is failed. Default value
parameters.help_zh:
即时用户同步创建（JIT Provision）开启状态。取值：
Enabled：开启，SAML 登录时若用户池中无同名用户，将自动创建。
Disabled（默认值）：关闭，未找到用户时登录失败
parameters.name: jit_provision_status

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status of updating user information through synchronization. Valid values:
Enabled: The update is enabled. If a user with the same name exists during SAML logon, the user information is updated based on the attributes (DisplayName and Description) passed by the IdP.
Disabled: The update is disabled. Only the logon state is updated, and user attributes are not updated. Default value
parameters.help_zh:
通过同步更新用户信息开启状态。取值：
Enabled：开启，SAML 登录时若同名用户存在，会根据 IdP 传入的属性（DisplayName、Description）更新用户信息。
Disabled（默认值）：关闭，仅更新登录态，不更新用户属性
parameters.name: jit_update_status

parameters.help_en:
The SAML protocol binding type. Valid values:
HTTP-Redirect: AuthnRequest is sent by using HTTP redirect. Default value.
HTTP-POST: AuthnRequest is sent by using HTTP POST
parameters.help_zh:
SAML 协议绑定类型。取值：
HTTP-Redirect（默认值）：通过 HTTP 重定向方式发送 AuthnRequest。
HTTP-POST：通过 HTTP POST 方式发送 AuthnRequest
parameters.name: saml_binding_type

SSOIdentityProviderConfiguration.description_en: The detailed configurations of the identity provider

JITProvisionStatus.description_en: The enabling status of Just-In-Time (JIT) user provisioning. A value of Enabled indicates that JIT user provisioning is enabled, and a value of Disabled indicates that it is disabled
JITProvisionStatus.description_zh: 即时用户同步创建开启状态。Enabled 表示开启，Disabled 表示关闭

JITUpdateStatus.description_en: The enabling status of updating user information through synchronization. A value of Enabled indicates that the update is enabled, and a value of Disabled indicates that it is disabled
JITUpdateStatus.description_zh: 通过同步更新用户信息开启状态。Enabled 表示开启，Disabled 表示关闭

SAMLBindingType.description_en: The SAML protocol binding type. Valid values: HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST
SAMLBindingType.description_zh: SAML 协议绑定类型。HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST

SSOStatus.description_en: The enabling status of single sign-on (SSO). A value of Enabled indicates that SSO is enabled, and a value of Disabled indicates that SSO is disabled
SSOStatus.description_zh: 单点登录启用状态。Enabled 表示开启，Disabled 表示关闭

X509Certificate.description_en: The content of the X.509 certificate in PEM format
X509Certificate.description_zh: PEM 格式的 X509 证书内容
